subject: FinSafe: Vendr portal onboarding checkpoint and ephemeral evidence plan
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@finsafe.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: gcho@procurement.acme.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding to Vendr + short SOC2 / SIG exports

Hi Stephanie / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our procurement timeline, we want to get the FinSafe profile into Vendr this week so your security team can run the CAIQ/SIG comparison and mark any follow-ups before we enter contract review.

I attached a condensed SOC 2 one-pager and a machine-readable SIG export (zipped in the platform originally). For now the main asks from our side:
- Please confirm the Vendr tenant you want us to use (we see two possible org slugs).
- Any special evidence handling rules for ephemeral credentials (we rotate keys frequently).
- Expected SLO for review completion so procurement can estimate the window.

Attachments: FinSafe_SOC2_Summary.pdf (application/pdf), SIG-export-FinSafe-20270620.json (application/json)

Happy to hop on a quick 20 min call if useful.

Best,
Alex Torres
Security & Compliance, FinSafe Inc.
alex.torres@finsafe.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@finsafe.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, gcho@procurement.acme.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding to Vendr + short SOC2 / SIG exports

Alex — thanks for sending these. Glad the demo helped. Quick answers inline: 

- Vendr tenant: use the profile under https://app.vendr.com/orgs/redwood-inc/vendors/finsafe — that’s the one tied to our procurement flow.
- Ephemeral creds: we accept ephemeral proof artifacts uploaded to the profile as time-limited presigned objects; please include proof-of-possession screenshots and an access TTL note. We will not store raw keys.
- Review SLO: standard intake is 5 business days for an initial pass; if we see scope gaps we’ll ping for targeted artifacts and can often close within 48 hours after receipt.

Next steps I propose:
1) You upload the SIG-export JSON to the Vendr profile and mark it as "initial intake".
2) Marissa (copied) will do the CAIQ mapping and flag any SOC2 evidence we need.
3) If anything is sensitive, upload to the profile with the "do not retain" flag and notify us — we’ll request ephemeral access.

I’ll book a 20-minute sync at 11:30 PDT if that works for you.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Security Integrations, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, Alex Torres <alex.torres@finsafe.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, gcho@procurement.acme.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding to Vendr + short SOC2 / SIG exports

Thanks — I pulled the SIG JSON and started the quick map. Notes from the first pass: 

- Most controls map cleanly to the CAIQ matrix; I found a small cluster (Access certification, Privileged access logging, and KMS rotation evidence) where we need either a screenshot of your IAM role policy or an S3 presign proof showing the signed object TTL.
- SOC2 one-pager looks good; can you also attach the SOC2 control matrix that lists the control owners? The one-pager is helpful but we need the mapping table for our audit trace.

Attached: example-presign-template.txt (attachment stub) — use this to name the presigned object and TTL in the upload comments.

From a handling perspective, we will:
- Create a short "ephemeral evidence" folder inside the Vendr profile with 7-day retention.
- Request only time-limited presigned URLs for private keys or service-account JSONs — do not upload those directly.

If you can drop the control-owner matrix and a sample presign URL into the profile, I’ll finish the CAIQ mapping today and post any follow-ups as checklist items in Vendr.

Marissa
Security Intake, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, Alex Torres <alex.torres@finsafe.com>
Cc: gcho@procurement.acme.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding to Vendr + short SOC2 / SIG exports

Quick confirmation — I created the Vendr checklist items and set the review target to 2027-06-28 (initial pass complete). Items I added: 
- CAIQ mapping in progress (owner: marissa.cole)
- Request control-owner matrix (owner: Alex Torres)
- Ephemeral presign example uploaded (owner: FinSafe)
- SOC2 evidence folder: FinSafe_SOC2_Summary.pdf (we’ll link this to the checklist)

Alex — when you add the control-owner matrix, please include a line for the KMS rotation practice and the last rotation timestamp. That will let us avoid a follow-up call.

If anything slips we’ll escalate but this looks straightforward. Thanks all.

Jonas Weber
Vendor Security Operations, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
